summary: 27-year-old ex-military male, depressed and possibly suicidal, last seen the evening of Feb 8 after a bike accident; his vehicle was found stuck on an unplowed road NW of Blackhawk. Alpine and SARDOC dog teams searched Feb 11-12; a SARDOC dog located him deceased well west of the vehicle.
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team; SARDOC; Gilpin County Sheriff's Office; Front Range Rescue Dogs
notes: Alpine 2015 Missions PDF item 15-06/07. Search ran two days; paged again 02/12 as day 2 SARDOC Feb 11-12 2015 mission report: subject was a 27-year-old ex-military male, depressed and possibly suicidal; last seen Sunday evening 2/8 after a bike accident (uncle picked him up from the hospital, last sighting); vehicle found stuck on an unplowed road NW of Blackhawk; Facebook post 'Sorry about the mess, see you at Kingston' (Kingston Peak ~4 mi W of vehicle); paracord and an empty knife sheath in the jeep. Two SARDOC dog teams plus two Front Range Rescue Dog teams fielded; a SARDOC dog located him deceased well west of the vehicle on 2/12. OUTCOME CORRECTED run 534: row said rescued-uninjured (Alpine PDF item 15-06/07 is outcome-silent); corrected to fatality per the explicit SARDOC report.
